card.capacity_status_quote: We pretty much remain sold out for our 2026 capacity. So that is continuing to be true for us at this point of time.
card.demand_direction_quote: Demand for CoreWeave Cloud continues to intensify.
card.pricing_power_quote: Demand for CoreWeave Cloud is accelerating and we remain largely sold out of our 2026 capacity with prices increasing across the board from Ampere to Hopper to Blackwell.
card.guidance_direction_quote: We are reaffirming our full year guidance, including full year revenue, full year adjusted operating income and that we will exit the year with low double-digit adjusted operating income margin.
card.constraint_owner_quote: The constraint in AI is no longer whether enterprises and AI labs want to deploy. It is how quickly high-performance, reliable AI cloud capacity can be delivered.
